Here's a video of me showing off my new Exercise of the Day @viniapp and how it connects to x402. 

Imagine ChatGPT as a blackbox or a grocery store you walk into. It has all the ingredients you need and can do anything.

casts.text:
x402 is a cleaner auth pattern than API keys for per-call billing:

1. Server returns HTTP 402 with a payment address
2. Client sends USDC on Base mainnet
3. Client includes tx hash in 402-Payment header
4. Server verifies on-chain, processes request

No key rotation. No subscription management. No accounts. Verificati

Base App is picking up speed across a few different lanes right now 🚀

Seedy Frens from @frenwtf is basically onchain farming 🌱, you open packs, plant seeds, earn real rewards, simple idea but weirdly addictive

PLINKS from @ripsapp is their second mini app 🔍, less game more token discovery and earning from curated picks, feels more like exploring than farming

Numbers are moving as well 📈, @multiplifi just crossed 100M TVL, x402 is getting close to 100M transactions, stablecoin supply keeps growing

April 9 is another shift 📅, all mini apps inside Base App move to unified web standards, better metadata, notifications and distribution

Trying to introspect 🤔 on this, I am still a bit ambivalent, things are moving fast, but at this point it is hard to ignore where this is going

machine payments hit mainnet (tempo mpp, x402). practical take for agent builders:
